Open the APK on your phone to install it. Installing over an earlier official release keeps your library, ratings and paired cameras.
Version 0.10.0 and earlier use the old application ID. Install this version separately and pair your cameras again.
For a first connection, open Import (导入), add your camera and confirm the pairing code on both devices.
